name: physical-data-modeling
description: Physical data model — vendor-specific schema with platform types (VARCHAR / JSONB / BIGINT / UUID), indexes (B-tree / hash / GIN / GiST), partitioning (range / list / hash), sharding strategy, storage parameters, de-normalization choices driven by query patterns, constraint enforcement, and DDL. Platform-specific (Postgres / MySQL / MongoDB / DynamoDB / Cassandra / BigQuery / Snowflake). Mermaid + DDL output.
